title: Hugo was a fantastic...
text: Hugo was a fantastic guide. He was extremely knowledgeable about the flora and fauna of Doñana and had an answer to nearly every question we asked. A highlight of the trip was that he brought his own  personal Zeiss spotting scope (thousands of $, a real treat for birders) for us to use. It made the wildlife sightings (flamingos, ibis, spoonbills, deer, boar) that much better. I strongly encourage the company to purchase their own so he doesn't have to bring his. It was roughly 100$ for a 10-hour trip. Insanely good value for the price.
author: Kelt_W

title: It's a nice day. The...
text: It's a nice day. The emphasis is on wildlife. Lots of birds, semi wild horses, and dear. The dunes at the shore were impressive. Lunch was good, our guide was friendly and knowledgeable.
author: George_W

title: A magnificent discovery of Doñana National Park with Naturanda!
text:
We spent a superb day discovering Doñana National Park with Naturanda and especially with José, a truly top-notch guide! 😊

On the agenda: discovery of the rice fields, the fauna and the flora, including flamingos, deer, horses, and a multitude of birds. 🦩🌿

We also really liked the small village of El Rocío, where we felt like we were in a Zorro movie! Here, no paved roads, but streets covered in sand where the inhabitants get around on horseback or by jeep. A truly amazing and exotic place!

title: A tour to discover authentic Andalusia!
text: Doñana Park is very beautiful, as is El Rocio; we went swimming at a very beautiful beach. Alvaro was excellent and very kind. Highly recommended tour. Thank you
author: Adventure485805

title: Beautiful day of discoveries
text: Great day out with Abraham, who was very friendly and described the landscapes, rice paddies, and animals in the park to us. The season may have been poorly chosen to see more birds. Then a stop in El Rocio, a western-style village and place of pilgrimage; an educational tour in the reserve and a visit to the hunting lodge, then on to the ocean: a shared lunch at the restaurant, then time to enjoy the beach. It is possible to bring your own picnic. Return to Seville in 1 hour and 30 minutes. We did not suffer from the heat
author: isarnaud

title: Doñana National Park
text: Wonderful sightings of birds. Sergio the guide was excellent and very knowledgeable. He also took us to a very nice restaurant.
author: Road62262509596

title: 10/10 Experience
text:
Honestly a 10/10 experience. Our guide was very informative, helpful, great cheerful personality. Really understood the history of each ecosystem, animals and trees. Great itinerary so you always had rest time and toilet stops. It's a long day but worth the early wake up time - we are even able to see the National Eagle take a snake and some baby Linx, with a good amount of deer and plenty of flamingos to see.

I'd recommend booking this if you're in Sevilla and want a good planned day out, even if it's just to enjoy the beach breeze on a hot day.
author: Dreamer688063

title: The day in Doñana was beautiful, and the guidance was very good.
text: I have loved the day. The landscapes of Doñana are beautiful, but above all, our guide, Miguel Álvarez, treated us with such care and explained everything we saw so well and beautifully that it made the whole group feel united and happy sharing it. Thank you very much.
author: 125rosamariap

title: A fantastic way to spend a day.
text: A fantastic way to spend a day.  We saw much more than we expected (mostly birds), including some at very close range. Our guide, Luis, clearly knew what to look for and where. Excellent value, highly recommended.
author: Paul1234567890987654

title: Birdlife Heaven
text: It really was a great day in all and good value for money. There was a change in start time which meant we had to get up very early. Miguel was great and Sonia the guide on the 4x4 bus was so knowledgeable and so passionate about wildlife and the ecology of this beautiful park. Did not see Lynx, but hey they are solitary and elusive.  We saw 7 different species of heron, flamingos galore, eagles and much more.
